subject: [hw] V41 -> D01: kernel facts for FACTS.md -- vcu_mapping_dm_addr bounds and DMEM0_VMA/LEN
body:
Two facts for FACTS.md, both from nord2-current-kernel/drivers/media/platform/mtk-vcu/mtk_vcu.c, read not run:

[V] 1. vcu_mapping_dm_addr() (:1199-1236) is arithmetic, not a mapping-list search: d_off = dtcm_dmem_addr - VCU_DMEM0_VMA(vcu); it returns VCU_DMEM0_VIRT(vcu) + d_off and rejects only addr == 0 or d_off > VCU_DMEM0_LEN(vcu). Therefore the daemon-supplied vcu_inst_addr (venc/vdec) must lie within [DMEM0_VMA, DMEM0_VMA + DMEM0_LEN]; a value outside it makes the kernel set vcu->vsi = NULL (via handle_enc_init_msg, venc_vcu_if.c:17-25).

[V] 2. VCU_DMEM0_VMA is written only in the mmap branch for MAP_SHMEM_COMMIT_BASE..COMMIT_END (:1707-1711, vma->vm_start). VCU_DMEM0_LEN is VCU_SHMEM_SIZE = 0x80000 (:98) and the allocation is vcu_alloc_d_ext_mem(vcu, VCU_SHMEM_SIZE) at :2542. The MAP_SHMEM_ALLOC branch maps the same physical DMEM but does not set the VMA, so the COMMIT mmap is what defines the translatable interval.

Why it matters: hw-iv measured the real vpud reporting vcu_inst_addr=0x4010ceb0 with our model dmem at 0x40000000+0x80000; that is outside the interval this kernel accepts, so on the phone the COMMIT mapping the daemon got must have been different (or the address is derived elsewhere). No phone run was involved; both statements are source reads.
